subject.title: fix(agents): retry same profile before timeout auth rotation

question: Should this PR intentionally add one same-profile timeout retry before fallback/auth-profile rotation and carry the empty aborted-assistant transcript repair, or should either the fallback gate or sibling repair ordering change before merge?
rationale: The code path is plausible and well covered, but the changed fallback timing and duplicated session-state repair are compatibility and merge-order choices that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Accept retry and bundled repair
options.body: Treat the one extra same-profile timeout as intentional compatibility behavior and let this PR carry the aborted-leaf repair.

options.title: Restore previous fallback timing
options.body: Keep fallback-configured setups on the old immediate fallback/rotation path and narrow this PR to non-fallback timeout retry only.

options.title: Wait for sibling repair first
options.body: Land or close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95766 first, then refresh this PR so only one branch owns the transcript repair.

recommendation.title: Accept retry and bundled repair
recommendation.body: Treat the one extra same-profile timeout as intentional compatibility behavior and let this PR carry the aborted-leaf repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the clearest current-main owner signal for the embedded runner timeout/failover and prompt-repair surfaces touched by this PR.
